title: NSA source at collusion meetings with a tech company

tellings.quote: I have a guy who is with NSA who was in meetings with some of the senior seuite people at a major tech and telecommunications company sort of colluding

plain: Someone at the NSA is said to have sat in meetings with senior executives of a major tech and telecommunications company where the two sides were "sort of colluding." Steven Greer, a former doctor who campaigns for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, tells Michels this came from his NSA contact. He names neither the man nor the company, and says only that it was collusion, not what was agreed.
